description: Creates a free invoice as a PDF without an InvoiceQuick account and returns a preview link and a PDF link that work for 60 days. It does not email anyone. Ask the user for the sender and recipient details; do not invent names or email addresses.

currency_code.description: ISO code from list_currencies. Defaults to USD.

date_format.description: How dates are printed on the PDF. Defaults to MM/DD/YYYY.

discount_percent.description: Discount on the whole invoice, in percent.

due_at.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days after the issue date.

issued_at.description: Issue date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

notes.description: Notes for the recipient. Links are not allowed.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms printed on the invoice. Links are not allowed.

title.description: Short description of the work, printed as the invoice subject.

name: generate_free_invoice
title: Generate free invoice
